name: grokipedia
title: Grokipedia
description: Find articles of information about a given topic from Grokipedia.
author: Visual-Studio-Coder

commands.name: search-grokipedia
commands.title: Search Grokipedia
commands.description: For a given string, find the articles on Grokipedia relating to it.

tools.name: search-articles
tools.title: Search Articles
tools.description: Search Grokipedia for articles about a topic and return titles, snippets, article links, and pagination.

tools.name: get-article
tools.title: Get Article
tools.description: Read a Grokipedia article by its slug or Grokipedia URL, including its Markdown content and source citations.
